assignments.node_id: יחזק ויגבר מחשבתו על איזה דבר שבעולם
assignments.reason: This node describes the act of strengthening and intensifying thought on any matter in the world. Its essential nature is the activation of מחשבה (thought) at full potency — the very mechanism that Package 1 identifies as identical to physical reality. The Torah opens with 'דע שהמחשבה יש לה תקף גדול ואם יחזק ויגבר מחשבתו...' — this node IS the exercise of thought-power, which is the dominant concept of Package 1. It is not martyrdom or sanctification (Package 2) but the universal faculty of thought applied to any domain.

This node describes the actualization — making it happen in reality. Its essential nature is מציאות בפועל (actual reality), the result-side of the thought-reality identity declared by the Torah. Package 1 is built around the bechina that thought and actual reality are the same thing; this node names the reality-side of that equation. The text frames this not as a separate causal outcome but as the natural identity: intensified thought IS actualization. This belongs with מציאות בפועל and מחשבה in Package 1, not with the holy martyrdom domain of Package 2.
